key_insight: DiagTrace evaluates whether LLMs can seek information incrementally to reconstruct documented diagnostic trajectories, rather than only produce a final diagnosis.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark tests information-seeking behavior relevant to clinical reasoning under incomplete information, without establishing readiness for patient care.
method: Build source-grounded cases from PubMed Central case reports.
Provide an initial presentation, event bank, clinical course, and diagnostic references.
Assess clinical-course alignment, interaction quality, and efficiency.
evidence_signal: DiagTrace contains 510 cases across eight specialties; evaluation of four LLMs on 225 cases revealed trade-offs in coverage, source-consistent ordering, and turn use.
watch_item: Alignment with published case-report trajectories may not reflect prospective diagnostic performance in real-world care.
paper_title: DiagTrace: An Interactive Benchmark for Clinical Decision Making
